name: Entity Slug
description: Implements a field that stores a URL-friendly slug for an entity.
project_description: Entity Slug provides generic, configurable slugging functionality for any fieldable entity by adding Slug and Slug Path field types. It does not enforce any particular use for the slug; it simply lets an editor type text (optionally containing tokens) into a field, which is then converted to a URL-friendly string on save via a stack of pluggable "slugifier" plugins. Shipped slugifiers include a token replacer, a Pathauto cleaner, an entity token replacer, an entity alias replacer, a term-parent token replacer, and a short-circuit fallback selector. The Slug Path field type composes multiple slugs together into a "/"-separated path. Slugifiers are an extensible plugin type, so custom slug transformations can be added by other modules.
